svg.title: Known-best packing of 127 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=127 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-17 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 127, read exactly from the retained source file n127/n127_exact.json at a1ba501, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#1020 names: a tilted central band of 57 squares inside a frame of axis-aligned squares, from an arrangement in the Kaggle compilations of Alex Chilton and Asterios Panoras. Finite construction feasibility only; local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=127 known best: side ~ 11.80079373 (certified upper bound)
